translation.name: GOD ETER AGERKE NAMDERASEM TUMA YENBO

book.name: ROM
book.title: ROM Pol ere Rom komri tatame emne bas rasem siglou.

content: Israelri tatame eme God eteri wule beke met.
Ari mase, God ere Israel tatame emne sene pette, an etep kenake abobe. Etepkap an God erne worwor etep wolabe.
Aren an kemne sekenke wobe, Israel tatame eme God eteri wule tobote kenake abobe. Tobote abobe, eme kuyese beke tobo. Eme God erne noub beke met, eteke eme kuyese beke tobo.

God ere tatame emne sene peten yenbo tebekap eme me eiksebe. Eiksen, eme etep wobe. Neremri murek nema God ere Moses erne newom wule noub tobobe, epkap nema tatame yenbo tetan. Etep wobe, eme God eteri kulke beke te. Etepkap ere emne tatame yenbo beke wo.
Krais eterke God ere Moses erne newom wule ere omom. Omomke, tatame eme Krais erne som abobetete, God ere emne etep wote. Kem ari tatame yenbo. Etep wote.

Moses ere kiyi basem siglou etep wom. God ere tatame emne tame yenbo wote wule ere gwopkap. God ere ane newom wule tatame eme noubwai tobote, wule yaper wuri beke kip nen, eme noub som temente. Moses ere etep wom.

Som abobe wule etep wobe. Kem selpapke mane etep abote. Eike Hevenke yawon Krais erne panen yeirte? Kem mane etep abote. Eike gabo komke yin Krais erne panen yate? Eike nemne God eteri tuma wusoute? Kenawaike abobe wule etep beke wo.

Kenawaike abobe wule etep wobe. God eteri tuma kemne mekinke yan tetan, ere keremri selpapke tetan. Ete tuma ere keremri elemoike tetan, keremri porerek tetan. Etep wobe. E Jisas eterne kenawaike abobe tuma nema kemne wusoube.

Metye. Kem keremri elemoike etep wote. Jisas ere Aneyen. Etep won kem keremri porerek kenawaike etep abote. Jisas ere sam, God ere erne wou sene newom, ere sele meike sene wayen yim. Kem etep won etep abote, God ere kemne peten eteri komke panen yite, kem noub temente nenbe.

Tatame eme etemri selpapke kenawaike abobe, ete tatame emne God ere etep wobe. Kem areri tatame yenbo. Etep wobe. Tatame eme etep wobe. Jisas ere Aneyen. Etep wobe, God ere ete tatame emne peten eteri komke panen yite, eme noub temente nenbe.
God eteri siglou etep wobe. Tatame eme Jisas erne kenawaike abobe, eme sebera beke kip ya. Etep wom.

Juda tatameken Juda berai tatameken eme sebera beke ya, pap yaper beke te. Jisas ere Juda etemri Aneyen, ere Juda berai tatame etemri Aneyenken kir. Ere tatame nogwape etemri Aneyen. Eike erne wolate, ere emne noubwai nente.
God eri siglou etep wobe. Tatame eme Aneyen Jisas erne etep wote. Aneyen, ne ane kobo late. Etep wobe tatame, God ere emne peten, eme noub temente nenbe. Etep wom.

An kemne wolabe. Jisas erne kenawaike beke abo tatame eme erne mapeke wolate, ere emne kobo late? Eme God eteri tuma beke met, eme erne kenawaike mapeke abote? Tatame eme God eteri tuma beke wusou, akeite tatame eme mapeke mette?
God eri tuma wusou tame emne beke won yi, eme mapeke yin wusoute? God eteri siglou etep wobe. God eri tuma yenbo wusoube tatame eme yan tuma wusoute, e yenbosubuwai. Etep wobe.
Israel eme God eteri tuma yenbo meten abolawoyim.
Tatame akei eme God eteri Tuma Yenbo wanwouke metem, Aisaia eter, ere etep abon etep wom. Aneyen, nema wusoubetem tuma, tame eme ete tuma kenawaike beke abo. Etep wom.
Etepkap, tame eme Krais eter nenbetemkap wusoube, tatame eme ek meten Krais erne kenawaike abobe.
An wolabe. Tatame eme God eteri tuma metem, o eme beke met? Ye, eme metem. God eteri siglou etep wobe.

content.text: God eteri tuma wusoube tame eme kom komke yin wusoubetem, eme gene komri tatame emne God eteri tuma wusoubetem.

content: Etep wom.
An sene wolabe. Kap Israel tatame eme God eteri tuma kuyese metem o? Ye, eme metem. Moses ere emne kiyi etep wom.

content.text: God ere etep wom. Akeite nowselri tatame eme eteri tatame tete nenbe. Kem Israel, kem etep late, kem selpap yaper tete. Porereken berai tatame an emne noub eyarte nenbe. Kem etep late, kem pap wayete nenbe.

content: Etep wom.
Yuri Aisaia ere muresen etep wom.

content.text: God ere wom. Ane beke la tatame eme ane lam. Arene beke wosop tatame an emne etep wom. An gwo genik tetan.

content: Etep wom.
Sene God ere Israel tatame emne etep wobe.

content.text: Wan gwolebe tatame, tuma naswoibe tatame, kwokwos kwokwos an emne let tayen pap yewote wobe.

content: Aisaia ere etep bas rasem.
